name: surprise_s6_unit_mismatch_manifest_reupload
covers: surprise 6: a collection pass retires part of a writer's fresh units while the commit key matches; the manifest names retired units, so the retry re-uploads the manifest as well, under a fresh key, and the surviving unit of the first attempt stays an orphan that no commit names

labels.A: begin ordinary commit; A: upload u/A1: a: open, commit: ten of the eleven unit uploads; the eleventh upload is held until the pass has listed
labels.GC: begin pass; GC: list keys (4); GC: r: gc: read commit key, mark, read fence, then list, held until the tenth upload is applied: ten new units are candidates, the eleventh is not yet there
labels.GC: remove [u/A1.0.g0] (check-only commi: gc: retireChecked of the ten candidates while the commit key is still the version the pass read
labels.A: commit CAS -> 409 on unit u/A1.0.g0 (: a: the commit-key write, held until the batch is applied, names a retired unit: commit:failed; the second commit step is the retry
labels.A: upload u/A1.0.g2; A: upload m/A1.1.g3: a: the retry builds the whole tree under fresh keys, the manifest among them: nothing of the first attempt is named again
